match_semantics: Lowercase the page hostname and strip one leading "www.". A rule matches when its host equals the hostname (or the hostname ends with its host_suffix) and, if it has a path_prefix, the URL path equals the prefix or continues it at a "/" (a prefix that ends in "/" is a plain prefix). When several rules match, the most specific wins: one with a path_prefix beats one without, a longer path_prefix beats a shorter one, an exact host beats a host_suffix, a longer host_suffix beats a shorter one; remaining ties go to the first rule in file order.
status_rule: ok: at least 3 recommendations that passed the full evaluation (export-guarded relationship, Replacement Fit publishable and a credible alternative). partial: 1 to 3 minus 1. none_yet: none. Quick scores, corpus pairings and demand never change a status.
